note: Default fade schedule. Numbers are design choices to be tuned with real learners, not research findings.

stages.label: Full points
stages.help: Every word shows its vowel points.

stages.label: Points on new and look-alike words
stages.help: Points stay only on words you have read fewer than newAfter times, and on words whose spelling matches another word.

stages.label: No points, tap to reveal
stages.help: Words show without points. Tap a word to see its points; a tapped word does not count as read unaided.
